newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - July 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - July 16.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Wednesday:
* Gianni Versace, the fashion designer, was shot dead at the front gate of his Miami home and police say they are seeking Andrew Cunanan, who is a suspect in four other killings as well.
* The head of Russia's space agency proposed that American astronaut Michael Foale take the place of the Russian commander on the space walk to repair the Mir space station.
* After baking New York City in a foggy haze, the summer's first heat wave gave way Tuesday to fast moving thunder storms.

* In Senate hearings, John Huang was depicted Tuesday as the highly paid agent of an international conglomerate that has close ties to the Chinese government and a record of generous contributions to the Democratic party.
* NATO was planning to follow up last week's arrest of accused war criminals in the Balkans with another raid but France declined to participate, thinking it too risky.
